headline: White House removes national cyber director after tech outages
pages: National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross has been fired after a little over a year in the job, according to CBS, the BBC's US news partner. CBS reports he lost the confidence of White House chief of staff Stephen Miller. Asked about it Friday, President Trump said Cairncross was not "good enough". The firing follows a string of outages that hit banking, air traffic control and other sectors. US officials say the outages were not caused by cyberattacks, but members of Congress have demanded a clearer explanation. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said this week there was "zero evidence" the outages were connected.
Rubio posted that Kirsten Davies, the Defense Department's chief information officer, is the new national cyber director. The White House had not officially confirmed the removal. Source: BBC
